name: aps-mrp-nodejs
description: APS MRP 系统 Node.js + TypeScript 复刻版，逻辑与 Python 原版完全一致。

scripts.admin: npm run build --silent && MRP_MYSQL_HOST=localhost MRP_MYSQL_PORT=13306 APS_HTTP_PORT=8080 node dist/admin/server.js
scripts.pull:raw-base: npm run build --silent && MRP_MYSQL_HOST=localhost MRP_MYSQL_PORT=13306 PULL_MODE=full PULL_CONCURRENCY=5 PULL_STAGGER_MS=0 node dist/phases/pullImaf.js
scripts.pull:raw-base:incr: npm run build --silent && MRP_MYSQL_HOST=localhost MRP_MYSQL_PORT=13306 PULL_MODE=incr PULL_CONCURRENCY=5 PULL_STAGGER_MS=0 node dist/phases/pullImaf.js
scripts.pull:modules: npm run build --silent && MRP_MYSQL_HOST=localhost MRP_MYSQL_PORT=13306 node dist/phases/puller.js
scripts.pull:all:full: npm run pull:raw-base && npm run pull:modules:full
